messages:
carol: FYI premerge scan on PR #12034 flagged a SAST rule around KMS signing usage and DAST found a replayable token proof against the admin proxy. Needs triage. artifact: gs://ci/12034/scan.json

sam: paste the snippets?

carol: from the CI artifact:
```
SAST: auth/jwt_signer.go:42 - use of kms.AsymmetricSign without key version pinning (rule RDX-KMS-SIGN-01)
DAST: POST /admin/login -> response includes bearer token that replays successfully against /admin/health
artifact: gs://ci/12034/scan.json
```

diego: tagging @ria for infra/KMS context  any recent RBAC changes granting sign rights to CI or deployer accounts?

ria: we rolled a script that consolidated KMS roles last week; it created a group binding that included roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier for the rollout-sa in staging. That binding was intended for a different key (code-signing) but may have been applied broadly. I'll pull the keystore audit and IAM bindings.

security-bot: Automated scan summary: 1 HIGH (weak KMS signing hygiene), 2 MED (token replay), 4 LOW. Triage suggestions: assign owner, reproduce token replay, export KMS audit slice, and consider SDLC policy for AsymmetricSign usage + linter rule to require key version pinning.

infra-oncall: I can repro in staging and check which principal used AsymmetricSign. If rollout-sa got signer rights on application keys, that's an issue. I'll start a sandbox replay and attach audit logs.

sam: code excerpt from jwt_signer.go for context:
```
func SignJWT(payload []byte) (string, error) {
  resp, err := kmsClient.AsymmetricSign(ctx, &kmspb.AsymmetricSignRequest{
    Name: "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/auth/cryptoKeys/jwtKey",
    Digest: &kmspb.Digest{Sha256: sha256.Sum256(payload)[:] },
  })
  if err != nil { return "", err }
  return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(resp.Signature), nil
}
```
No explicit key version is used here.

carol: SAST flagged RDX-KMS-SIGN-01 because we require explicit cryptoKeyVersion pinning for signing keys used for auth tokens. Without it, revocation/rotation semantics are ambiguous. Also DAST shows a token issued can be used to impersonate admin until rotated.

diego: repro notes: I replayed the CI flow and saw that the rollout-ci job requested AsymmetricSign at 2025-06-04T11:03Z and the signer principal was rollout-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com. That principal currently has signerVerifier on jwtKey due to the recent binding. Audit slice attached to RED-12022.

ria: attaching audit slice to RED-12022 (created)  found sign requests from rollout-sa and from the deploy job. Also found an IAM change PR #1019 that added the rollout group to signer role with a broad resource pattern. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-12022

security-bot: Reminder: any IAM change granting signer roles should include explicit resource scoping and ticket reference. Consider PLCY-KMS-SIGN-01 to require keyVersion pinning for auth tokens.

sam: proposed triage: 1) owner = auth team (sam) for code fix 2) infra to revoke unintended signer bindings 3) reproduce replay in staging and rotate jwtKey if exposure confirmed 4) add linter rule (RDX-LINT-KMS-01) to flag AsymmetricSign without version or comment justification.

carol: I'll own the DAST repro and will coordinate with infra-oncall to revoke the binding in a safe window. Please add action items to RED-12022.

infra-oncall: removing the unintended signer binding in staging now. Will note in keystore-change log and attach the change entry. Doing removal at 12:15 UTC.

diego: local mitigation for auth: I'll open a PR to require explicit keyVersion in call sites and to verify the signer returned keyVersion matches the expected version. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/auth/pull/1212 (WIP). Also adding a test that simulates a revoked key version.

sam: since tokens can be replayed, we should rotate jwtKey and issue a short grace period. Ria, can you coordinate a rotation and publish the rotation plan in RED-12022?

ria: yes. Planning a rotation at 13:00 UTC for staging jwtKey, will update RED-12022 and include audit export and rotation steps. Rotation will be non-disruptive; we'll pin new keyVersion in the code before cutover.

security-bot: Suggested SDLC updates: 1) add PLCY-KMS-SIGN-01 requiring explicit cryptoKeyVersion for any signing of auth tokens 2) add premerge linter rule RDX-LINT-KMS-01 3) require two-approver signoff for IAM bindings granting signer roles.

carol: re-run DAST after removal + rotation. Early repro shows token replay fails after key rotation. Logged verification in RED-12022.

sam: merging PR changes that enforce keyVersion param and add runtime check; will coordinate with ria for a short deploy freeze during pinning.

ria: rotation done at 13:03 UTC; audit exported and attached to RED-12022. rollout-sa signer binding removed.

diego: follow-ups: add linter rule PR and a devex doc on keyVersion pinning best practices. I'll file RFC.

carol: action items in RED-12022: sam->code fix + tests, diego->linter + RFC, ria->rotation + IAM rollback, infra-oncall->audit exports, carol->DAST re-run and verification. ETA initial verification today EOD.

security-bot: Thread archived to RED-12022. Remember to update SDLC checklist and enforce RDX-LINT-KMS-01 in premerge policies. :lock:
